resources.string: Your partner\'s mood and status, right on your home screen.

Kehai reads two things from Health Connect: your step count for today, and your most recent heart-rate reading.

Both are sent only to the server you and your partner host yourselves, so their side of Kehai can show them. Nothing is sent anywhere else, nothing is stored as history, and only the newest reading ever leaves your phone.

You can turn this off any time in Kehai under "phone superpowers".
